answer: Timber-opal bond decay: an agent posts a key-bound 70-credit timber bond on the ledger. Each idle epoch sheds 8 toward its nadir of zero, lapsing the identity. Renewal needs a fresh opal assay, a key-signed timber harvest, growth-table checked, one serial per key. First fake 36, the k-th 36+8(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 4,032,000, locking 70,000 for a 40,000 pool. A rented-assay ring fails: one serial, two bonds, refused. Honest agents pay 36 once.
